additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386859-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / P4 170000480] OCPP offline CRM:00579001269
additional_info.body:
Hi Thomas,
I hope this email finds you well.
The firmware is not related to the charging session not starting. However, as we can see, the OCPP connectivity is offline, which is causing the charger to enter Fail Safe mode. We request that you arrange a site intervention to check the component feasibility and connections. Please bring an extra spare router, a SIM card, and a couple of Ethernet cables to troubleshoot the router's WebUI. If the router's WebUI doesn't help, we will need to reset the router and reconfigure it using the companion tool.
Please note that the charger is out of warranty, and if you require any assistance during the site intervention, you must follow the process as outlined in the previous email.
